title: SO-2.13 Commercial integration services that keep the open-core boundary neutral
request: Closes G-SO-24. Source: the master traceability baseline of 31 October 2026 (section 8.6) and, where named, the Scope One addendum (PR #222, docs/scope-one/ADDENDUM-ARCHITECTURE-AND-DELIVERY-REVIEW.md at head a1757a0); 8.3 to 8.6 released for contracting by the owner on 31 Oct 2026. This contract is the design-record stage: it asks for the decision record and builds nothing. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository. The programme decomposition on branch docs/engine-decision-tiers-reconcile (docs/scope-one/programme/) is read for overlap: WP15-01 and WP15-02 hold the licence boundary and WP16-07 the pricing dimensions; this contract is the service boundary and takes none of them. Owner decision 31 Oct 2026: local-first, the cloud only a relay and a backup.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: Paid managed, hosted or enterprise services that do not compromise the neutral open-core boundary

Do not let cloud availability become a hidden dependency for local project integrity.
